name: Viper Rod
body:
School evocation; Level: druid 5, serpent warlock 5, snake cultist leader 5, witch 5

Components: V, S, M (a snake fang)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Duration: 1 minute/2 levels

The caster summons a rod of the viper that he may use without restriction, regardless of his alignment, for the duration of the spell. The caster is considered proficient with the rod, and the rod will not work for anyone else. Unlike the actual magic item, victims struck by a summoned rod of the viper become immune to its poison once they make a successful save. The rod disappears when the spell ends.
